pixel_convention: x right, y DOWN, origin top-left, full-resolution pixels

camera.motion: static (frame differencing shows no change outside the moving parts; background pixels identical frame to frame)
camera.view: side view of a white catering/cargo truck (front facing right) in a gray hangar; near-orthogonal to the truck's long side, camera at about the height of the cargo-box roof (underside of the box is visible while it is high, top face hidden at rest)
camera.scale_note: 2D scene: one metres-per-pixel scale from the prior object; box and truck side are roughly in the same plane (box sits on the truck roof centreline, so its front face is a bit behind the truck side panel -> small scale difference possible)

objects.name: box
objects.description: brown cardboard box with 'FRAGAIL' handling symbols on its right part, one open top flap at its right end; the only freely moving rigid object
objects.reference_point: centre of the front face (cx, cy) = rest-centre + template-matched displacement

size_px.note: front face at rest (frame >= 74): x 529.5..937.5, y 216.5..407.5; flap rises ~15 px above the top edge at the right end and is NOT part of the size. Depth (into the scene) not measurable in this side view.

start_position_px.note: frame 0: front-face top edge at y=-36 (cut off by the image top), bottom edge 154.8; a ~34 px underside strip is visible below it (y 155..189)

objects.motion: pure vertical drop (cx constant 733.5 +/- 0.03), no visible rotation

objects.name: truck
objects.description: white catering truck (high-loader) with large white cargo box, white railing/platform on top of the cab at the right, cab facing right

overall_length_rear_to_cab_front.note: rear tail-lift bracket to cab front face; mirrors stick out to x~1840; +/-5 px

cargo_box.note: roof y 409-410 is where the box lands

rear_wheel.note: tyre approx x 622..788, eyeballed from grid, +/-8 px

objects.name: rear_leg
objects.description: rear stabilizer leg (black column with yellow warning stickers, red round foot) just behind the rear wheel, x~487
objects.motion: extends straight down slowly through the whole clip: foot centroid y 1026.5 (frame 0) -> 1059.1 (frame 199), ~33 px; red foot ~40 px wide, ~12 px tall

objects.name: front_leg
objects.description: front stabilizer leg (same type, red foot) just behind the cab / in front of the fuel tank, x~1283

objects.name: small_black_jacks
objects.description: two small black jack pads (x~550 and x~1245, y~1000-1030) that also lower during the clip; not tracked separately (dark on dark)

objects.name: tail_lift_plate
objects.description: dark gray plate (tail lift / ramp) behind the rear of the truck, visible only left of x=128; folds up from almost horizontal (y~805) and disappears behind the cargo box by frame ~182
objects.reference_point: centroid of visible dark pixels (partial object - unreliable as a position)

objects.name: background
objects.description: hangar wall with vertical light-gray pillars, large dark window grid at upper right (x 1230-1710, y 15-320), gray floor with white dashed markings near rear wheel

events.event: box release / start of fall (from rest)
events.note: per-frame drop grows linearly from 0.04 px (frame 0->1); extrapolated zero-velocity point ~frame 0.6

events.event: box first contact with truck roof (impact)
box second contact / comes to rest
